GeneDef.label: reptilian
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have the cold-blooded body of a reptile momo: tough scales that blunt cuts and claws, a warmth-loving disposition, and a body that lays a single egg rather than birthing live young. Once a year she sheds her old scales, which can be worked like fine leather.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Tough scales: modest resistance to sharp damage.
Cold-blooded: minimum comfortable temperature raised by 10°C.
Lays a single fertilized egg instead of giving live birth.
Sheds her scales once a year, leaving a stack of workable reptile scales.

GeneDef.label: lamia tail
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have the long, powerful serpent tail of a lamia. In a fight she can lash out with it, drag an opponent into her coils, and constrict them while she teases their will away.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Can grapple an opponent with her tail: drags them into her coils and constricts them, building tease damage until their will breaks.
